answer.justification: Median first divergence is 7 and edit distance 0.591, both in the fine-tuned range. Top-1 agreement 0.910 and KL 0.095 are moderate, also fine-tuned. Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.085, with 0.196 at layer 16 and 0.411 at layer 32, a large final-layer jump of +0.108 and cosine 0.908. The mid-layer size ratio is 1.022 (growth), effective rank 3.05 and direction consistency 0.700, all matching fine-tuned. Raw-score shift ÷ TV of 9.2 is also in the fine-tuned range. Quantized is ruled out by the size ratio above 1, the high direction consistency, the low effective rank and the late large final jump. System-prompted is ruled out by the small layer-2 spike of 1.9, the first divergence at 7 rather than 0, and the edit distance below 0.79. Base is ruled out because every difference is non-zero.
